blocks.tamil_translation: he will meet Allah Ta'ala on the Day of Qiyamah in a state where Allah Ta'ala is angry with him. If a person earns wealth in a halal way with the intention of keeping away from begging from others, fulfilling the needs of his family, and doing good to his neighbours, on the Day of Qiyamah he will meet Allah Ta'ala with his face shining like the full moon on the night of the fourteenth,” Hazrat Abu Hurairah (RA) narrates that Rasulullah ﷺ said.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنِ الْحَسَنِ رَحِمَهُ اللهُ قَالَ:قَالَ رَسُوْلُ اللهِ ﷺ:مَا مِنْ عَبْدٍ يَخْطُبُ خُطْبَةً اِلَّا اللهُ سَائِلُهُ عَنْهَا: مَا اَرَادَ بِهَا؟ قَالَ جَعْفَرُ: كَانَ مَالِكُ بْنُ دِيْنَارٍ اِذَا حَدَّثَ هذَا الْحَدِيْثَ بَكَي حَتَّي يَنْقَطِعَ ثُمَّ يَقُوْلُ: يَحْسَبُوْنَ اَنَّ عَيْنِيْ تَقَرُّ بِكَلَامِيْ عَلَيْكُمْ فَاَنَا اَعْلَمُ اَنَّ اللهَ سَائِلِيْ عَنْهُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ مَا اَرَدْتَ بِهِ.
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Hasan (RH) narrates that Rasulullah ﷺ said, “If a person gives a speech, Allah Ta'ala will certainly ask him what his purpose was in giving that speech.” Hazrat Ja'far (RH) says, “When narrating this hadith, Hazrat Malik ibn Dinar (RH) would sob and weep until his voice choked. Then he would also say, “People think that my eyes are cooled (I feel happy) by giving Bayan before you. I know that Allah Ta'ala will certainly question me on the Day of Qiyamah about the purpose for which I gave the speech.”
